entries.78ea04f583251d99: The company is a non-consolidated company headquartered in Yoyogi, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo, and had 69 employees as of December 31, 2025. It listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market in December 2024.
entries.7dd4c75075a7acbb: A legal tech company that provides the legal SaaS "OLGA" and an online registration support service.
entries.8bb1977e6e0fcdbd: “ＯＬＧＡ” is offered as an integrated package of four modules, namely an AI legal assistant, a legal data platform, AI contract review and contract management, and can also be introduced module by module. A distinctive feature is that issue detection in AI contract review can be customized to each client company’s own criteria, and that legal matter information is consolidated in the legal data platform so that past knowledge can be reused.
entries.8ca242f0b911f33c: The company provides “ＯＬＧＡ” legal automation as a cloud service and also provides services that support online change of registration, acquisition of registry records, and preparation of trademark application documents.
entries.9e174d4e3f63483b: Under its purpose “Eliminating the barriers between law and all activities,” the company aims to start with work-efficiency products for the legal departments of large companies and for specialists, expand to company-wide solutions that include business divisions, and extend its scope to small and medium-sized enterprises and, in the future, individuals. As medium- to long-term initiatives, the company says it will strengthen collaboration among the modules of “ＯＬＧＡ,” expand functions to support company-wide adoption of “ＯＬＧＡ,” and enhance existing products and develop new products in its registration business.
entries.a1692de2b649df8d: The domestic SaaS market and legal tech market are both expected to grow, and the company is seeking to expand its target from markets for legal departments and law firms to company-wide markets aimed at segments with relatively low legal literacy, such as business divisions.
